what: A hand-drawn illustration overlapping a photo corner, once it has received its full drawing, pops up from 50% of its height below and transparent over .3s ease-in-out to −25% and then settles in place (fully visible at the midpoint, 50%) — --fx-delay is staggered per drawing at .5, .8 and 1s. look: hop makes the inner drawing hop twice (.3s) by −15% on hover

options.on: Default is after all images have arrived (load). ready: right on attach, scroll: once when it enters the 85% line of the screen (needs ScrollTrigger)
options.start: When on: scroll, the ScrollTrigger start, default top 85%
options.look: With hop, there is no first bounce, on hover the child right below hops twice
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-delay · --fx: Duration (.3s), curve (ease-in-out), delay, hop repeat count (2)

from.where: index.html Hero three hand drawings (.5·.8·1s, original .pyon) · FAQ header hand drawing bounces on hover (look: hop, original .faq_hd_illust:hover pyonpyon)
